_about: Public-domain St Peter of Alcántara (1499-1562, Franciscan reformer) in English for the Word Hoard: A Golden Treatise of Mental Prayer, translated by Giles Willoughby (Philadelphia: M. Fithian, 1844), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
